name: Call of Earth

angles.text: As a shaman, you use saptas to attune your spirit to an element and commune with its spirits.
As a Skyborne, you may be adrift high in an endless sea of clouds and estranged from the four winds. The earth gives you a steady foundation for understanding.

faq.answer: An Earth Sapta is a magical brew that attunes your spirit to the element of earth. With enough resolve, you can see elemental spirits hidden from ordinary sight.
Drink the Earth Sapta at the Rise of Spirits, northeast through a pass. Saptas are consumed only on sacred ground.
faq.q: Where must the Earth Sapta be consumed?

aliases: why drink sapta at sacred place
faq.answer: Saptas are potent brews that join mortal spirits with the elements. Shamanic tradition requires drinking them at sacred sites to commune with the spirits.
faq.q: Why must saptas only be drunk in sacred places?

aliases: who is child of the four winds
faq.answer: The earth spirit greets you as a child of the four winds because you seek to learn why the winds have departed.
faq.q: Why does the spirit address the seeker as a 'child of the four winds'?

faq.answer: Even the earth spirit at the Rise of Spirits does not know why the wind spirits have grown distant or where they have gone.
faq.q: Why have the spirits of the winds left?

aliases: how does earth help with winds
faq.answer: The earth teaches strength and resolve. Even amid an endless sea of clouds, you remain tethered to the earth. Learning its steadiness is the first step toward speaking with the four winds again.
faq.q: How does communing with the earth help someone reconnect with the winds?

sections.body: Shamans drink saptas to open their sight to the elemental world. Each brew attunes a mortal spirit to one realm and reveals spirits usually hidden from view. Only those with enough resolve can bear their power. Select practitioners guard the knowledge of these brews.
sections.title: The Nature of the Sapta

sections.body: You travel northeast through a pass to the Rise of Spirits, where initiates commune with the earth. Saptas are drunk only at sacred sites. On consecrated ground, the draught lets you pierce the veil and see what the spirits choose to reveal.
sections.title: The Rise of Spirits

sections.body:
After you drink the Earth Sapta, an elemental guide greets you as a child of the four winds. You seek to learn why they have departed. The earth spirit cannot explain the wind spirits' motives, but teaches you strength and steadfast resolve.

Even high above, amid an endless sea of clouds, you must first anchor yourself to the earth. Only then can you speak with the winds again.
sections.title: Strength of the Earth

summary: At the Rise of Spirits, you drink an Earth Sapta and meet an elemental guide. The earth's strength may help you seek the winds again.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Earth
